metadata.title: Corporate Chauffeur Accounts Prague
metadata.description: Corporate chauffeur accounts for Prague-based and international companies. Monthly invoicing, dedicated account manager, priority dispatch. Set up in 24 hours.
metadata.ogDescription: Corporate chauffeur accounts for Prague-based and international companies. Monthly invoicing, dedicated account manager, priority dispatch.

serviceDescription: Dedicated corporate chauffeur accounts with monthly invoicing, account manager, and priority dispatch for companies operating in Prague.

hero.label: Corporate Accounts · Prague
hero.intro: PRESTIGO corporate accounts are designed for companies that move people regularly and expect every detail handled. Fixed rates, monthly invoicing, a named account manager, and a fleet that reflects the standard your organisation holds itself to.

pricingCallout.label: Corporate pricing
pricingCallout.heading: Volume pricing available
pricingCallout.note: Rates negotiated based on monthly trip volume

benefits.title: Monthly Invoicing
benefits.body: One invoice. All trips. All departments. Sent on the first of every month, formatted for your accounts team, with full trip breakdown.

benefits.title: Dedicated Account Manager
benefits.body: A single contact who knows your company, your travellers, and your preferences. Available by phone, email, or WhatsApp.

benefits.title: Priority Dispatch
benefits.body: Corporate accounts get priority allocation. Same-day bookings, last-minute changes, and early-morning airport runs — handled.

benefits.title: Reporting Dashboard
benefits.body: View all bookings, travellers, costs, and routes in one place. Export for expense reporting at any time.

builtFor.title: Prague-based companies
builtFor.body: Transferring executives, clients, and VIP guests daily from Václav Havel Airport.

builtFor.title: International companies
builtFor.body: With staff visiting Prague regularly who need a reliable, bookable ground transport partner.

builtFor.title: Event & conference organisers
builtFor.body: Coordinating multi-vehicle group movements for delegations and incentive travel.

howItWorks.title: Apply
howItWorks.body: Fill in the enquiry form. We review your requirements and set up your account within 24 hours.

howItWorks.title: Book
howItWorks.body: Your team books online or via the account manager. No per-trip approval process needed.

howItWorks.title: Invoice
howItWorks.body: One monthly invoice covering all trips. Pay by bank transfer or card. Full GDPR-compliant data handling.
